| **Repo** | `box/github.com/opencharly/pod-immich:v2026.327.0043` |

Immich self-hosted photo and video management server on port 2283 with its
machine-learning backend on port 3003 in the same image — face recognition,
smart search and OCR run in-process, no second image.
Builds the Immich Node server from source with pnpm into /opt/immich/server,
the Vite web UI into /build/www, the plugin-core Extism WASM plugin into
/build/plugins/immich-plugin-core, and the reverse-geocoding geodata into
/build/geodata; installs a PostgreSQL-aware startup wrapper and an idempotent
DB-migration wrapper; provisions the Python machine-learning virtualenv
(/opt/immich/machine-learning/.venv) from the pinned uv.lock with the CUDA
ONNX Runtime extra and supervises it as immich-ml on port 3003. Library,
cache, import, external media and ML models live under ~/.immich. The
behaviour is verifiable as the built server bundle, the web build, the WASM
plugin, the geodata set, the image-codec toolchain, the seeded init SQL, the
CUDA execution provider in the ML venv, and live /api/server/ping on 2283
plus /ping on 3003.

## Services

- `immich-db-init`
- `immich-server`
- `immich-ml`
